messages.subject: For Juan Santamaría | Next-generation infrastructure, government partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear ACS Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Juan Santamaría Cases, Chief Executive Officer.

ACS Group's next-generation infrastructure strategy across digital, energy, transport and other strategic sectors requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, clients, communities and operating teams. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support ACS Group's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to ACS Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
